speaker: Serafina
cn: （质问）你怎么买得起这辆车？这车可是全球限量的！我让我爸爹地帮我买都没买到！这车不可能是你的！
en: (Questioning) How can you afford this car? It's a limited edition! Even my dad wasn't able to get one for me! This car cannot possibly be yours!

speaker: Damián
cn: 怎么不可能？车就在外面你要不要去看看？
en: How is that impossible? The car is right outside—would you like to take a look?

speaker: 同学一
cn: （笑）都是同学，干嘛弄得这么僵。Damián，这是我的名片，以后有什么事需要我的都可直接联系我。
en: (laughs) Hey, we’re all old classmates. No need for any hard feelings. Damián, here’s my card. If there’s ever anything I can do for you, just give me a call.

speaker: Damián
cn: （看了眼桌面上的菜）同学聚会，怎么就点这么几个菜啊。（看Serafina）Serafina，你爹地那么有钱，怎么请同学们吃得这么寒酸啊。
en: (glances at the dishes on the table)

speaker: 服务员
cn: 这是黑金卡，你在我们店里的消费完全免费！
en: This is our Black Card. Everything you order here is on the house!

speaker: Serafina
cn: （尖叫）Damián，你怎么有这张卡？这可是Elorza家族中心成员才会有的卡！
en: (Screams) Damián, how do you have that card?! Only core members of the Elorza family are allowed to have one!

speaker: Damián
cn: 把你们店里的波士顿龙虾，还有顶级牛排按人头上，用这张卡结算。
en: One Maine lobster and one of your finest steaks for everyone here. Put it all on this card.

speaker: Damián
cn: （勾起嘴角）你们接着吃吧，我还有事先走了。
en: (smiling) Enjoy the rest of your meal. I’ve got somewhere else to be, so I’ll get going.

speaker: Damián
en: (laughs)No need to pay the bill just yet.

speaker: Damián
cn: （腹黑）菜正常上，钱该谁付就找谁。
en: (Cunningly) Keep the food coming. As for the bill, charge whoever’s supposed to pay for it.

speaker: Damián
en: What did you just call me?

speaker: 服务员
cn: 老板啊。昨天经理给我们培训，说见到这张卡的持有者叫老板就好。
en: Boss! Our manager told us yesterday that anyone carrying this card is to be addressed as “Boss.”

speaker: Damián(VO)
cn: （咋舌）Samanta竟然把整个店都送给我了！
en: Samanta actually gave me the whole restaurant?!
